description: Institutional paperwork from the shelter — requisitions, denials, transfers, inspections, assignments, incidents, rosters, chits, and notices. The texture of communal survival administered. Most are mundane. A few are not. The horror is in the form.

GENERATOR INSPECTION — WEEKLY
Form 14-G

Date: Day 21
Inspector: Tomas (engineer, senior)
Unit: Meridian 4-cyl diesel, model K, 1971

Hours run this week: 168 (continuous)
Fuel consumed: 96 litres (heating oil, grade 2)
Fuel remaining (tank): 184 litres
Fuel remaining (reserve drum): 40 litres

Cylinders:
  Cyl 1: nominal
  Cyl 2: nominal
  Cyl 3: KNOCK (bearing, see note)
  Cyl 4: nominal

Injectors: cleaned twice this week. Third cleaning due Day 24. Gasket: improvised (leather, boot). Holding.

Oil: black, changed Day 18. Next change: Day 32 or on pressure drop.

The power is a supply. The supply is a week, maybe two.

documents.title: Incident Report — Missing Stores, West Locker
documents.material: Pre-printed form, fields filled in pen, marked PRIORITY
documents.transcript:
INCIDENT REPORT
Form 9-I

Date of incident: between Day 20 (evening) and Day 22 (morning)
Date of report: Day 22
Reported by: Quartermaster

Location: West locker (stores, sub-level 1)

Description: Two sacks of flour (milled, 25kg each) missing from the west locker. Lock not broken. No sign of forced entry. Access limited to key-holders (3: QM, Duty Clerk, Steward).

Inventory impact: Flour reserve reduced from [number on file] to [number on file]. The number on file is the number on file. The number in this report is the number in this report. The two numbers are the same number. The number is lower than the number I have been reporting verbally. This report corrects the verbal number. The verbal number was forty-two. The number is eleven. The number has been eleven for some time. This report is the first time the number is the number.

Suspected cause: Key-holder access. Internal. Not a breach. A decision made by a key-holder without the Quartermaster's authority.

Action taken: Lock changed. Remaining stores moved to QM office. Verbal report to Captain of the Gate. No public notice. The number is not public. The number is in this report.

Quartermaster note: I know which key-holder. I am not writing which key-holder in this report. I have spoken to the key-holder. The key-holder states the flour was issued to the night watch, who were under-rationed. This may be true. The night watch were under-rationed. That is also my error. Two errors do not make a distribution. This report is the report.

documents.title: Incident Report — Minor Injury, Sub-Level 3

INCIDENT REPORT
Form 9-I

Date of incident: Day 56, approx 23:00
Date of report: Day 57
Reported by: Sub-Level 3 Steward

Location: Sub-level 3, stores, aisle 4

Person(s) affected: Stock-picker (name on file), night shift

Description: Stock-picker sustained a fall in the unlit aisle 4. No wired lighting (see IR-3-11, Day 45). No candle issued (see Requisition 7-L-12, pending). Stock-picker fell against the rack, sustained a laceration to the forearm and a contusion to the knee. Ambulatory. Treated at Clinic (wound cleaned, bound). Two days light duty prescribed.

Cause: Insufficient illumination. The aisle is dark. The aisle has been dark for eleven days. The candles were requested. The candles were approved (6). The candles have not been issued. The candles are in the Quartermaster's office. The candles are not in sub-level 3.

Action taken: Night shift consolidated to 22:00-02:00 (see QM note, Req 7-L-12). Stock-picker on light duty. Aisle 4 closed at night pending candles.

Steward note: This is the second injury in the dark. The first was Day 52, also aisle 4, also a stock-picker, also a fall. The first was not reported because the stock-picker did not report it. This one is reported because I am reporting it. The dark is the dark. The dark is not an accident. The dark is a decision. I am reporting the decision.

documents.title: Evacuation Order — Downstream Settlements, North Dam
documents.posted_by: Dam Operator (relayed via Relay Station Kestrel-9)
documents.location: Gate house, received by radio, transcribed
documents.material: Handwritten on gate house log paper, radio transcription
documents.transcript:
EVACUATION ORDER — RELAYED

Received: Day 4, 03:30, via Kestrel-9 relay
Origin: North Dam Control (operator, single)

TEXT OF TRANSMISSION:
"This is North Dam. The spillway gate is stuck open. The reservoir is rising. I cannot close it alone. The manual winch takes two. I am one. If the water overtops the emergency spill it is the town downstream. I have sent my family to the high school. I am telling you to send everyone to the high school. The high school is the high ground. Send them now. I will stay on the winch. I will call when the gate is closed or when the gate is not closed. North Dam out."

Action taken by Gate House:
- Runner dispatched to downstream settlements at 03:45.
- Captain of the Gate notified 04:00.
- Evacuation to high ground (school) begun 04:15.

Follow-up (Day 5, dawn): Dam operator's family confirmed at the school. Dam operator confirmed at the dam. Gate closed, Day 5, 04:00 (approx). Reservoir dropping. The town is fine. The town does not know. The town is the high school now.

Relay note: The dam operator said the winch takes two. He is one. He closed it. The math is wrong. The math is the math. The man is the man. The man is more than the math.

QUARANTINE ORDER
Form 6-Q

Date: Day 19
Effective: immediately
Location: Ward B (full ward)

Reason: Respiratory presentation in two patients, consistent pattern, possible contagion. Culturing unavailable. Precautionary quarantine pending clinical outcome.

Restrictions:
- No entry to Ward B except: medical staff, Duty Clerk (supervised).
- No exit from Ward B except: medical transfer (see Transfer Order 3-T-05, to Clinic sheeted bay).
- Meals delivered to the ward door. Ward B residents do not attend the mess hall.
- Water: filled at the pump by the Duty Clerk, delivered. Ward B residents do not use the public pump.

Duration: Until lifted by the Doctor. The Doctor lifts when the cough is clear or the cause is clear. Neither is clear. The quarantine is the quarantine until it is not.

Doctor note: The sheet is not a wall. The sheet is what we have between the sick and the not-sick. The sheet is not medicine. The sheet is the policy. The policy is the sheet. I am the doctor. I am also the policy. That is not in the form. The form has a field for the doctor. The form does not have a field for the policy. The policy is in the margin. The margin is where the doctor writes. The margin is where the doctor lives.

documents.title: Notice — Weapons Amnesty, Voluntary Surrender

documents.transcript:
NOTICE — WEAPONS AMNESTY

Date: Day 60
Posted by: Captain of the Gate

All residents are invited to voluntarily surrender personal weapons to the Gate House for the duration of the shelter emergency.

This is not a search. This is not a seizure. This is an invitation. The invitation is voluntary. The voluntary is the word. The word is the word.

Surrendered weapons will be:
- Catalogued (by the Duty Clerk)
- Stored (Gate House armory, locked)
- Returned to the owner on departure or on lifting of the emergency.

Residents who do not surrender will not be penalised. Residents who do not surrender will be asked why. The asking is not a penalty. The asking is the asking.

Reason: The shelter is a close community. The close community is a close temper. The close temper is a close violence. We have not had the violence. We do not want the violence. The weapons are the violence, waiting. The waiting is the reason.

Captain's note: I am not taking your blade. I am asking for your blade. The asking is the difference. If I take the blade, I am the violence. If I ask for the blade, I am the Captain. I am the Captain. I am asking.

- Ration reductions in effect since Day 23 (see Denial 12-D-04) were applied to a basis of 140. The basis is 147. The reductions were correct for 140 and are correct for 147. The 7 are the 7. The 7 include an infant who is not an infant. The form is wrong. The form is corrected. The correction is the form.

Quartermaster note: I have been carrying two numbers. The number in the book and the number in the shelter. The number in the book was 140. The number in the shelter was 147. The number in the book is now 147. The number in the shelter is 147. The numbers are the same. The book is the honest place. The book is now honest. I am tired. The tired is not in the form. MAINTENANCE CHIT
Form 5-M

Date: Day 18
Requested by: Gate House Sentry (night)
Location: Main entrance hatch, outer seal

Fault: Outer hatch seal perished. Rubber cracked through. Secondary seal (rope + tar, see prior repair) holding but compressing. Wind audible through the seal at night. Wind audible is air audible. Air audible is rad audible. Rad audible is not acceptable.

Priority: HIGH. The hatch is the door. The door is the shelter. The seal is the door. The seal is the shelter.

Assigned to: Maintenance, IMMEDIATE.

Maintenance note: Rubber perished. No rubber. Rope + tar (second application, see Day 9). Tar is low. Rope is low. The rope is the seal. The tar is the seal. The seal is the rope and the tar. We are sealing the door with what we have. What we have is rope and tar. The rope and the tar are the door. The door is the shelter. We are the shelter. We are the rope and the tar.

Date of request: Day 8

Item: Seed potatoes (winter variety, stored)
Quantity requested: 4 kg
Purpose: Planting, cold frame, against the season

Justification: The season is not the season. The spring is not the spring. The ground is workable now. The wall is south. The wall remembers the sun. I am betting on the wall. The bet is the bet. The potato is the bet. The bet is the spring. I am planting the spring in the autumn because the autumn is the only season I have.

QM NOTE (added Day 8): Approved, 4 kg. The farmer is older than the calendar. If the farmer says plant, I plant the potato. The calendar is wrong. The farmer is not. The harvest, if there is a harvest, is the spring. If there is no harvest, the 4 kg is the flour we did not lose. I am betting on the farmer. The farmer is betting on the wall. The wall is betting on the sun. The sun is gone. Someone is wrong. We are all betting.
